# Top Five Videos (Vid)

*Vid* is Vylet Pony’s loud, mischievous alicorn video host, whose ridiculous online “top five” rankings grew into a character with a serious emotional arc. Her partner is **Dubstep Growl (“Dub”)**, a nonverbal alicorn DJ—not an alternate identity of Vid. They are characters in Vylet’s own *Wayfarer/Top Five Videos* continuity, inspired by *My Little Pony*, rather than characters from the *Friendship Is Magic* television cast.

[![Vid (left) with Dubstep Growl (right), holding pride flags — artwork by larvaecandy](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2024/6/10/3247073__safe_artist-colon-larvaecandy_derpibooru%2Bimport_part%2Bof%2Ba%2Bset_oc_oc-colon-dubstep%2Bgrowl_oc-colon-top%2Bfive%2Bvideos_unofficial%2Bcharacters%2Bonly_al.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/3247073)

*Artwork: larvaecandy, credited in the image post.*

- **Appearance:** Dark purple alicorn with a horn and feathered wings, a long, fluffy lavender-and-pink mane and tail, prominent ears and piercings, and an energetic, mischievous expression. Often drawn in a dark hoodie and sometimes with glasses; her cutie-mark imagery evokes a video/play icon. See the creator’s [2026 character reference sheets](https://www.vyletpony.com/top-five-videos-oc).
- **Names:** *Top Five Videos* is the creator-used character name and title of her comedy-video series; *Vid* (also *Videos*) is its familiar shortening, not an unrelated persona or fandom invention. The creator’s reference gives a longer personal name, **Gwenyth Vida Fernandez**, but specifically asks readers not to call her that.
- **Voice and appearances:** Vid **speaks**, unlike Dub. Vylet Pony performs the album’s vocals and Vid’s dialogue; **Lenval Brown voices Lodestar**, the separate figure representing Vid’s subconscious. Her material includes the [*top five videos 5* upload (2021)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XQxBLXv6aos), *Girls Who Are Wizards* (2024), and *Love & Ponystep* (2025), as identified in [Vylet’s music catalog](https://www.vyletpony.com/music). No *Friendship Is Magic* season/episode number applies. The [creator’s album notes](https://www.vyletpony.com/love-and-ponystep) identify *Love & Ponystep* as part of the *Top Five Videos* series.

## Important moments

These are **album scenes/tracks**, not TV episodes. Verified full-episode scene timestamps are unavailable, so the links go to the creator’s track pages.

1. **The heartbreak confrontation** — *Love & Ponystep*, track 2, “[Ch 1: SVU-AS (Heartbreak Intro)](https://vyletpony.bandcamp.com/track/ch-1-svu-as-heartbreak-intro-ft-lenval-brown)”: Lodestar challenges Vid’s attempts to escape the pain of her separation from Dub through bravado and gaming metaphors.
2. **Choosing self-love** — *Love & Ponystep*, track 14, “[Ch 3: Ballista (Dear Aria, I Love Myself)](https://vyletpony.bandcamp.com/track/ch-3-ballista-dear-aria-i-love-myself-ft-lenval-brown)”: When Vid asks how to stop hurting, Lodestar urges her to value herself before trying to repair her love life.
3. **More than a joke** — *Love & Ponystep*, track 16, “[Jester](https://vyletpony.bandcamp.com/track/jester)”: Vid reflects on being treated as a gag and recognizes that she deserves to be taken seriously.
4. **The reunion** — *Love & Ponystep*, track 20, “[Love & Ponystep](https://vyletpony.bandcamp.com/track/love-ponystep-ft-tracey-brakes)”: The finale explicitly brings Vid and Dub back together, resolving the album’s central relationship arc.
